title: Green Synthesis and Bioactivity of Aliphatic N-Substituted Glycine Derivatives.
authors: Jafari, Ameneh; Eslami Moghadam, Mahboube; Mansouri-Torshizi, Hassan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究N-取代甘氨酸衍生物的绿色合成及其与DNA的相互作用，虽涉及小分子-DNA结合和分子对接，但对象为小分子配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法以实验为主、AI/物理模拟深度有限，仅部分可借鉴。
abstract: Standard amino acids have an asymmetric alpha-carbon atom to which -COOH, -NH(2), -H, and -R groups are bonded. Among them, glycine is the simplest (R = -H) with no asymmetric carbon, and other natural amino acids are C-substituted of glycine. Here, we have designed and made a green synthesis of some new N-substituted glycine derivatives with R-(NH)CH(2)-COOH formula, where R is flexible and hydrophobic with different chain lengths and benches of the type propyl, butyl, sec-butyl, tert-butyl, pentyl, isopentyl, tert-pentyl, hexyl, 2-aminoheptyl, and octyl. These glycine derivatives were characterized by recording their melting points and FT-IR, mass, (1)H NMR, and (13)C NMR spectra. DFT studies revealed that 2-aminoheptyl glycine had the highest electronegativity value and can thus act as a good bidentate ligand for the metal centers. ADME comparative results and bioavailability radars indicated that both octyl- and 2-aminoheptyl glycine had the most lipophilicity, making them good agents in cell passing. Furthermore, lipophilicity determination showed that octyl glycine was the best and propylgly was more soluble than others. Based on solubility, lipophilicity, and dipole moment values, propyl- and 2-aminoheptyl-glycine were considered for bio-macromolecular interaction studies. Thus, the interaction of these two agents with DNA and HSA was studied using absorption spectroscopy and circular dichroism techniques. Due to the presence of the R-amine group, they can interact with the DNA by H-binding and hydrophobicity, while electrostatic mode could not be ruled out. Meanwhile, molecular docking studies revealed that octyl- and 2-aminoheptyl glycine had the highest negative docking energy, which reflects their higher tendency to interact with DNA. The DNA binding affinity of two candidate AAs was determined by viscosity measurement and fluorescence emission recording, which confirms that groove binding occurs. Also, the toxicity of these synthesized amino acid derivates was tested against the human foreskin fibroblast (HFF) cell line. They showed IC(50) values within the range of 127-344 muM after 48 h with the highest toxicity for 2-aminoheptyl glycine.
abstract_zh: 标准氨基酸具有不对称的α-碳原子，其上键合有-COOH、-NH(2)、-H和-R基团。其中，甘氨酸是最简单的（R = -H），没有不对称碳，其他天然氨基酸均为甘氨酸的C-取代衍生物。在此，我们设计并绿色合成了一些新的N-取代甘氨酸衍生物，其通式为R-(NH)CH(2)-COOH，其中R为柔性且疏水的基团，具有不同链长和分支类型，包括丙基、丁基、仲丁基、叔丁基、戊基、异戊基、叔戊基、己基、2-氨基庚基和辛基。这些甘氨酸衍生物通过记录其熔点及FT-IR、质谱、(1)H NMR和(13)C NMR谱进行表征。DFT研究表明，2-氨基庚基甘氨酸具有最高的电负性值，因此可作为金属中心良好的双齿配体。ADME比较结果和生物利用度雷达图表明，辛基甘氨酸和2-氨基庚基甘氨酸具有最高的亲脂性，使其成为良好的细胞穿透剂。此外，亲脂性测定显示，辛基甘氨酸为最佳，而丙基甘氨酸比其他衍生物更易溶解。基于溶解度、亲脂性和偶极矩值，丙基甘氨酸和2-氨基庚基甘氨酸被选用于生物大分子相互作用研究。因此，使用吸收光谱和圆二色谱技术研究了这两种试剂与DNA和HSA的相互作用。由于存在R-胺基，它们可通过氢键和疏水作用与DNA相互作用，而静电模式也不能排除。同时，分子对接研究表明，辛基甘氨酸和2-氨基庚基甘氨酸具有最高的负对接能，反映了它们与DNA相互作用的更高倾向。通过粘度测量和荧光发射记录确定了两种候选氨基酸的DNA结合亲和力，证实了沟槽结合的发生。此外，这些合成的氨基酸衍生物对人包皮成纤维细胞（HFF）细胞系的毒性进行了测试。它们在48小时后显示出IC(50)值在127-344 μM范围内，其中2-氨基庚基甘氨酸的毒性最高。
